# GPUI Base 0.10.0

`gpui-base` is the crates.io source from [Longbridge GPUI Kit](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/tree/f697c3133d55c64fa8a5b67926147fb3dadd276d/crates/base), distributed under Apache-2.0. RustText patches the editor's vertical geometry for multi-million-line documents (RustText #20).
